name: Machinedramon
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 level 5 [Cyborg] or [Ver.5] trait card from your hand or trash as this Digimon's top digivolution card, activate 1 [On Play] effect on the placed card as an effect of this Digimon.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, by trashing its bottom 2 face-down or [Cyborg] trait digivolution cards, it doesn't leave.
